result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps within a residential setting. However, safety is compromised by significantly faded crosswalk markings and the absence of dedicated pedestrian signals at the signalized crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are heavily worn and difficult to see, reducing driver awareness of the crossing zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: There are no dedicated walk/don't walk signals, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may lead to confusion or conflicts with turning traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal poles at the corners

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental or ladder-style thermoplastic markings to improve visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear timing information for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: A residential intersection featuring high-visibility continental crosswalks and curb ramps. While basic infrastructure is present, sightlines are partially obstructed by mature hedges and a parked trailer near the crossing.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large trailer and parked cars near the intersection, along with tall hedges, block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection and corner property.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not be timed for walking speeds.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a marked crosswalk within a residential neighborhood. However, the wide roadway increases pedestrian exposure, and the lack of visible pedestrian signals or high-visibility markings reduces overall safety.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are worn, reducing visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the intersection can create trip hazards or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with continental-style markings for better visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.
